summary: Updates the IANA allocation rules and the registry for IPv4 and IPv6 Router Alert Option values. The Router Alert Option signals routers to take a closer look at a packet. This document changes how new values are assigned. It updates RFC 2113 and RFC 3175 and is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: Some packages carry a flag saying look inside me. This document just sets the rules for who may invent new kinds of flags and how they are recorded.

questions: how are router alert values allocated
